releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.9 (User-Controlled Interactive ID Card Studio)
changelog:
✨ User-Controlled Interactive ID Card Studio (Zero Blind Automation):
• Interactive 4-Corner Loupe Crop: Draggable corner handles with 2.5x magnifying loupe immediately appear upon card photo capture or selection. Real-world printed bedsheets, textured fabrics, and wood grain desks are now 100% supported.
• Instant Landscape ID-1 Snap: After setting corners, the card is instantly perspective-dewarped, auto-rotated to landscape, and snapped to standard ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 proportions (85.60mm x 53.98mm).
• Adjust Crop Anytime: Tap 'Adjust Crop' on any card thumbnail to re-open corner pins and fine-tune borders in seconds.
• Lossless Filter Switching: Switch between Magic Color, Original, Sharp B&W, and Grayscale with instant lossless preview re-rendering.
• 1-Tap Official A4 KYC PDF Export: Generate standard 2-sided KYC A4 sheet with 1:1 scale and center cutting guide directly saved to Downloads.
